Metadata: Industry: AgriTech, Category: Cold Chain & Post-Harvest, Stage: MVP

Please evaluate the following StartupTN startup proposal:

Company Name: FreshVayal Logistics Pvt Ltd
Founder: M. Priyanka (B.Tech Food Technology, Anna University)
Location: Dindigul, Tamil Nadu
Proposal:
FreshVayal builds modular solar-powered cold rooms (5-ton capacity) for aggregation points near mango and tomato clusters in Dindigul and Theni belts. Farmers pay a per-crate storage fee via a mobile app; we also operate a shared refrigerated van fleet for last-mile transport to Chennai wholesale markets. Post-harvest losses in TN horticulture currently run 25-30% per NABARD estimates. Our MVP unit is operational at one aggregation center serving 40 farmers, cutting spoilage from 28% to 9% over one season. Revenue model: ₹2/kg/day storage fee plus ₹4/kg transport fee. TAM: TN horticulture output of 18 million tonnes annually. We seek ₹40 lakhs to build 3 additional cold rooms and a fleet of 4 refrigerated vans, plus StartupTN market linkage support with TN horticulture department.

Metadata: Industry: AgriTech, Category: FPO & Market Linkage Platform, Stage: Idea

Please evaluate the following StartupTN startup proposal:

Company Name: NalamKootu Agri Collective
Founder: S. Arun Kumar (MBA Agribusiness, TNAU)
Location: Thanjavur, Tamil Nadu
Proposal:
NalamKootu proposes a digital platform connecting Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs) in the Cauvery delta directly with institutional buyers (hotels, hospitals, exporters), bypassing multiple mandi intermediaries. The platform will use WhatsApp-based ordering for low-tech accessibility and a simple web dashboard for buyers. We have not yet built the product but have secured verbal commitment from 2 local FPOs representing 600 paddy and vegetable farmers. Revenue model: 5% commission on transaction value. We estimate the Thanjavur delta region alone has ₹800 crore in annual agri-commodity trade. We are requesting ₹8 lakhs seed grant and incubation support to build the MVP and formalize FPO partnerships.

Company Name: GramaSuvi Health Pvt Ltd
Founder: Dr. K. Meenakshi (MBBS, MD Community Medicine, Madurai Medical College)
Location: Madurai, Tamil Nadu
Proposal:
GramaSuvi operates kiosk-based telemedicine booths in primary health sub-centers across rural Madurai and Theni, staffed by ANMs who connect patients to remote doctors via video link, supported by basic diagnostic devices (BP monitor, glucometer, pulse oximeter, ECG). Company Name: NetraAI Diagnostics
Founder: R. Vignesh (M.S. Biomedical Engineering, IIT Madras)
Location: Chennai, Tamil Nadu
Proposal:
NetraAI has built a smartphone-attachable fundus camera combined with a deep learning model to screen for diabetic retinopathy in primary care settings, targeting Tamil Nadu's diabetic population of over 8 million. Our MVP has been validated on a dataset of 3,200 retinal images with 89% sensitivity and 85% specificity against ophthalmologist ground truth, though not yet through a formal clinical trial. We have conducted a small pilot with 150 patients at a diabetes clinic in Chennai. Revenue model: device + software bundle sold to clinics at ₹1.2 lakhs upfront plus ₹99/screening SaaS fee. We seek ₹75 lakhs and support navigating CDSCO regulatory approval pathway.
